method: Static audit of all 100 existing tests-directory files: local import resolution, filesystem path expressions, subprocess calls, Python AST imports, and DB-store/source constructor isolation. No tests were executed in this staging overlay.

hardcoded_python_interpreter.purpose: Validate generated SVG XML with Python standard-library xml.etree.ElementTree. This is an interpreter/environment dependency, not missing source.

test_runner_requirements: Run from project root with tests and project root importable. Python tests include imports of local test_server and tests.test_arcade; Node tests use node:test and built-in Node modules. No npm installation required by the literal test imports.
db_source_isolation: FocusStore calls pass temporary data/source paths. Live-capture subprocess explicitly passes --data-dir and --source under its TemporaryDirectory. Tests use synthetic fixture records; no production DB was opened for this audit.
